svg.title: MPx Spin v1 — how it goes together · exploded view
svg.desc: Illustrative exploded view of the MPx Spin v1 centrifuge-assisted filter, built from the concept's dimension set (dims.mjs, mm). The motor leaves the base from below; the rotor parts lift out of the bowl and are laid out in a row: basket with coupler, lip seal, O-ring and clamp ring, then the mesh wrap, the cellulose filter sleeve and the vane insert. A concept: not yet a manufacturing design.
